args.lower_description: Clear turquoise tropical ocean, subtle small pixel ripples, colorful pirate adventure RPG.
args.upper_description: Warm pale sand of a tropical pirate island, fine grain, scattered tiny shells.

args.description: Four separate tropical pirate port buildings in a precise 2 by 2 sprite sheet, one complete building per 256 by 256 cell, transparent margins between cells: red tiled seaside tavern, blue roof nautical market, stone and timber forge, small harbor office with a navigation flag. Orthographic high top-down RPG view with visible front facades, colorful adventurous island architecture inspired by One Piece, weathered wood, white plaster, brass, ropes, barrels, lush small plants, crisp detailed pixel art, consistent scale and lighting, no characters, no text.

args.upper_description: Lush emerald tropical island grass, tiny flowers and soft worn patches, colorful pirate adventure RPG.

cost_source: Observed subscription generation delta across this flow; no overlapping jobs were identified. No balances are stored.

buildings.notes: Four intact native-size cells. Output has a three-quarter RPG view; it is not strictly vertical orthographic.

verification.tiles: Two 16-tile 128x128 Wang atlases. Atlas regions read from bounding_box and corner metadata; no inferred sheet order.
verification.postprocessing: No edits to generated source PNGs. Separate magenta grid copies are inspection aids only. Game assembles native image regions as terrain and buildings.
